about: How people are dressed and seated in rooms (src/bench/whole-figures.ts), read against the people pack's manifest (src/bench/people-pack.ts). `dressOrder`: the pack's dress values a person wears, most fitting first: an official at a government place, someone at their own workplace, anyone else. `packSex`: the pack's word for a recorded gender; a gender not listed may be any of the pack's people. `olderHair`: the palette color someone 65 or older wears where their palette has it.

seatRoles.about: A seat a room keeps for an office, by the office kind on its records: the role a mannequin plate's spot carries. The holder takes it when present; anyone else may sit there when it is free.

creator.about: The creator's worded labels for the pack's values (src/bench/appearance.ts). A value not listed is shown in sentence case: a build as itself, an outfit by its manifest outfitLabel, a part as '<Part> color'.
